trend_flag.daily: Retain the group's existing confirmed 1D trend and benchmark gates.
trend_flag.four_hour: A 4-to-8-bar 4H consolidation in the trend direction, total width at most 3 ATR; a completed 4H candle closes at least 0.1 ATR beyond it and passes the group's existing relative-volume gate; STOP trigger beyond that candle.
trend_flag.stop: Beyond the opposite consolidation boundary by 0.25 4H ATR; reject risk outside 0.75-to-2.5 ATR.
trend_flag.targets: TP1 at 1.5R and TP2 at 3R, rounded toward entry.

breakout_confirmation.daily: Retain the group's existing confirmed 1D direction, BTC relationship and strength gates.
breakout_confirmation.four_hour: A first 4H close 0.1-to-1 ATR past the prior 20-bar high/low, group relative volume required; a separate next closed 4H candle confirms outside the level without returning inside; STOP trigger beyond the confirming candle.
breakout_confirmation.stop: Beyond the breakout level or confirming candle extreme by 0.25 4H ATR; reject risk outside 0.75-to-2.5 ATR.
breakout_confirmation.targets: TP1 at 1.5R and TP2 at 3R, rounded toward entry.

structure_range.daily: Only a completed neutral 1D regime and the group's existing BTC rule.
structure_range.four_hour: In the preceding 48 completed 4H bars, identify two spaced tests of each range boundary, a width of 4-to-10 ATR, and a directional rebound at the relevant boundary; STOP trigger beyond the rebound candle.
structure_range.stop: Outside the nearest range boundary by 0.25 4H ATR.
structure_range.targets: TP1 at the range midpoint and TP2 near the opposite boundary, only if rewards remain at least 1R and 2R.
